CHAPTER I PRELIMINARY CHAPTER II REGULATION AND REGISTRATION CHAPTER III MAHARASHTRA BOVINE BREEDING REGULATORY AUTHORITY CHAPTER IV FUNCTIONS AND POWERS OF AUTHORITY CHAPTER V OFFENCES AND PENALTIES CHAPTER VI FINANCE, ACCOUNTS AND AUDIT CHAPTER VII MISCELLANEOUS Section 1. Short title and commencement. Section 2. Definitions. Section 3. Regulation of bovine breeding activities. Section 4. Registration of semen station, ET or IVF laboratory, AITI, ART service provider with Authority. Section 5. Registration of semen bank, AI service provider and AI technician with District Deputy Commissioner, Animal Husbandry. Section 6. Procedure for registration. Section 7. Renewal. Section 8. Certification of bull. Section 9. Issue of duplicate registration certificate. Section 10. Revocation of registration certificate. Section 11. Appeal. Section 12. Establishment of Maharashtra Bovine Breeding Regulatory Authority. Section 13. Meetings of Authority. Section 14. Appointment of officers and other employees. Section 15. Functions of Authority. Section 16. Powers of Authority. Section 17. Power to inspect, search and seizure. Section 18. Power to make application to courts for restraining apprehended bovine breeding activities in contravention of this Act. Section 19. Penalties. Section 20. Offences by companies. Section 21. Compounding of offences. Section 22. Cognizance of offences. Section 23. Bar of jurisdiction. Section 24. Authority fund. Section 25. Accounts and audit. Section 26. Annual report. Section 27. Exemptions. Section 28. Power to give directions. Section 29. Maintenance of records and submission of returns. Section 30. Report of recognized laboratory. Section 31. Local authorities to assist. Section 32. All members and officials of Authority to be public servants. Section 33. Protection of action taken in good faith. Section 34. Power to make rules. Section 35. Power to make regulations. Section 36. Power to remove difficulties.
